settings.title: Quick commands
settings.help: Open it with {shortcut}. Pin or hide an item from the palette itself; it is remembered by its id, so renaming it keeps the choice.
settings.pinnedEmpty: Nothing pinned yet. Pin with the pin button at the end of a row in the palette.
settings.groupsHelp: The order of the groups in the palette. Turning a group off hides all its items, pinned ones too. The “Pinned” group is always on top.
settings.pinnedHelp: Shown in the “Pinned” group at the top of the palette, in pin order. Unpin an item and it goes back to its own group.
settings.hiddenHelp: Not shown in the palette, even when you search. Hiding a pinned item also unpins it. Show it again to use it again.
settings.resetOrderTitle: Back to the original order and turn every group on again
settings.resetOrderAsk: The groups go back to the original order and every group is turned on again.
